questions.text: Using V = Z x I x C x W, what is V for a Zone 4 building with Z = 0.40, I = 1.0, C = 0.12, and W = 5000 kN?

rationale.takeaway: For NSCP 2015 seismic-zone questions, use Zone 2 with Z = 0.20 and Zone 4 with Z = 0.40.

questions.text: Which of the following provinces is assigned to the lower seismic zone (Z = 0.2)?

options.text: Cebu, which is known for its vibrant culture and historical landmarks, but not typically for low seismic activity
Mindanao, a region with diverse landscapes and cultural heritage, yet it is not classified under the lower seismic zone
Palawan — one of three Zone 1 provinces (Z = 0.2) per NSCP 2015 Fig. 5-2
Luzon, the largest island in the Philippines, which includes the capital city of Manila and is not in the lower seismic zone

questions.rationale: Palawan is one of three Zone 1 provinces: Palawan, Tawi-Tawi, and Sulu. All other Philippines locations — including Batanes — are Zone 2.
